risks.title: PUC Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is entirely dependent on regulation by the Hawaii Public Utilities Commission, which affects revenue recognition, expenses, assets and liabilities. Regulatory liabilities reached $1.4B.

risks.title: Deferred Regulatory Assets
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory assets of $308M represent deferred costs incurred for which recovery depends on future tariffs approved by the PUC, creating uncertainty.

risks.title: Pension Obligations
risks.score_rationale: The company's pension obligations are material and could have a significant impact on results and liquidity.

risks.title: Maui Fire-Related Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company faces major litigation and settlement agreements following Maui fires, with a provision of at least $47.8M plus a derivative settlement of $100M, potentially having significant impact.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate risks on its material borrowings, including $500M issued in September 2025 at 6.00%.

risks.title: Liquidity and Financing Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company must raise substantial capital to finance settlement agreements for Maui fire-related litigation and infrastructure investments.

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: The June 2025 request to terminate Affiliate Transaction Rules (ATRs) and the revised request in October 2025 present regulatory uncertainty.
